{{Top|leg}}

'''Leafbrothers''' was a term used by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] to refer to other tribes and peoples. The Ewoks believed that all creatures were leaves on the same [[Spirit Tree (Endor)|Great Tree]], and shared the same experiences. [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]] used this reference in his speech to [[Chirpa/Legends|Chief Chirpa]] that the Ewoks of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] should join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in their fight against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="ROTJ Novel">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'' (novelization)]]</ref>
